subject: Re: Kickoff: sentence-level LMs for storyline coherence
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing and infra:

- Halima 60% (modeling), Gustavo 40% (embedding generation - the ~400k-sentence ROC set is downloadable, but our drafting corpus needs a fresh Beam run), Wanjiru 40% (serving integration).
- Paloma Castillo is committed at 65% to better_storylines for all of May 2026 - she owns the TFDS embedding pipeline and the coherence-scoring service, and both land in May. I've protected that allocation explicitly with her other leads; May is our crunch month and I don't want surprises.
- Compute: light. Sentence-level models train on a single node; the only real cost is the Beam embedding job, ~$6k of preemptible CPU.

Schedule note: TF2 stack for train/eval, but the from-scratch embedding path still wants a TF1 venv, so Gustavo is containerizing both to keep CI sane.

Bruno
